messages:
Priya (PM): Heads-up  we need to formalize the cut criteria for MVP vs v1. AC: we must avoid another timeline reset like last quarter. I'm proposing a 'cut kitchen' process: triage list -> must-have pass/fail tests -> customer impact signoff. Want quick takes.
Noah (Eng): Cut kitchen sounds good. Suggest we define 3 buckets: Must (blocker for launch), Strongly Desired (ship if time allows), Nice-to-have (post-launch). For Must: critical infra (RBAC), SSO for pilot tenants, embeddings cache. If any Must is > 20% incomplete across pilots, trigger canary hold.
Jin (Design): From UX: Must for pilot customers includes zero-loss message migration and clear fallback CTA. We'll add copy for degraded states.
Sam (SRE): Operational thresholds: rollback if error rate > 4% sustained 10m OR latency p95 > 1.7x baseline for 10m. Also add a 'customer pain' manual trigger if a pilot reports data loss.
Priya (PM): Two policy tensions: 1) engineering wants conservative auto-rollback rules to protect reliability, 2) sales/pilot ops want fewer timeline interruptions. We need an escalation flow. Propose: automatic hold -> ops notify triage -> 2-hr buffer for ops to mitigate -> PM + Eng decide.
Noah (Eng): Fine. Edge case: if migration already applied we can't rollback; instead we have to hotfix forward. We'll mark migrations as "apply-only" in the runbook.
Jin (Design): We'll produce a banner and modal copy for the 2-hr mitigation window. Include a "report an issue" quick link for pilot admins.
Sam (SRE): deploy-bot: Canary for mvp-cutlist-2026 initiated at 2026-03-23T15:10:56Z. Health checks: error_rate:4%,p95:1.7x; auto-hold=false.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary 5% healthy at 3m.
Priya (PM): Action items: - Noah: produce cut-kitchen checklist + bucket mapping - Sam: add manual "customer pain" flag to incident runbook - Jin: deliver banner/modal and quick-report link - Priya: draft escalation/playbook for timeline holds. Deadline: Fri EOD.
Noah (Eng): I'll start the checklist today.
Sam (SRE): Adding the flag to runbook now.
Jin (Design): Banner copy in PR by tomorrow.
Priya (PM): If no objections, I'll lock this as the launch gating process and add it to the launch checklist.
Noah (Eng): :thumbsup:
Priya (PM): Thanks team — let's avoid another big reset.
